description: This Java class defines a custom PasswordEncoder implementation, 'MessageDigestPasswordEncoder', used for encoding passwords with a message digest algorithm and salt. It provides methods for creating hashed passwords and verifying matches, utilizing configurable hash functions and secure random salt generation.

classes.name: MessageDigestPasswordEncoder
classes.description: A custom PasswordEncoder implementation that uses a message digest algorithm with salt to encode passwords, suitable for Hono-specific security requirements.

methods.name: MessageDigestPasswordEncoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the password encoder with specified hash function and optional SecureRandom for salt generation.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Creates a salted hash of the raw password, returning a string with salt and hash encoded in Base64.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Verifies if a raw password matches the stored encoded password by recreating the hash and comparing.

methods.name: digest
methods.description: Computes the hash of a password with an optional salt, using the configured hash function.

methods.name: randomSalt
methods.description: Generates an 8-byte cryptographically secure random salt.
